mx.teacher_note: Photosynthesis: glucose + oxygen -- in sunlight and chlorophyll --> carbon dioxide + water.

intelligence.enrichment: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll to produce glucose, and oxygen is released. Carbon dioxide + water -- in sunlight and chlorophyll -> glucose + oxygen. The learner correctly applies this rule: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll to produce glucose, and oxygen is released. The photosynthesis equation is just plant food plus sunlight, and the named materials can be placed on either side.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Respiration and transport in plants. The student must decide: Complete the photosynthesis relationship: carbon dioxide and water, in sunlight and chlorophyll, produce glucose and oxygen. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
